title: Aztec Empire (c. 1428-1521)
key_facts: Dominant Mesoamerican empire at Spanish arrival
Capital city Tenochtitlan was among world's largest cities
Complex society with advanced agriculture, mathematics, and astronomy
Conquered by Hernán Cortés with small force but native allies
causes: Military conquest and alliances with subject peoples
Control of valuable resources: obsidian, cacao, cotton
Religious and political ideology of divine rulership
Strategic location in Valley of Mexico
outcome: Fall of Tenochtitlan marked end of Aztec dominance
Spanish colonization and cultural destruction of indigenous knowledge
Massive population decline from disease and warfare
Founding of Mexico City on Aztec ruins

figures.name: Cuauhtémoc
figures.role: Last Aztec emperor; led final resistance

impacts: Created Spanish colonial empire in the Americas
Massive cultural loss through destruction of codices and knowledge
Established racial and social hierarchies that lasted centuries
